import pytest
from target import unescapeHTML

# Helper to compare expected output for known HTML entities
KNOWN_ENTITIES = {
    "&": "&",
    "<": "<",
    ">": ">",
    """: '"',
    "'": "'",
    " ": "\xa0",
}

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "inp,expected",
    [
        # None handling
        (None, None),
        # Empty string
        ("", ""),
        # No entities
        ("plain text", "plain text"),
        # Single known entity
        ("&", "&"),
        ("Hello <world>!", "Hello <world>!"),
        # Multiple known entities
        ("&<>", "&<>"),
        # Mixed known and unknown entities (unknown should stay unchanged)
        ("& &unknown; <", "& &unknown; <"),
        # Entity with numeric code
        ("'", "'"),
        # Entity with surrounding text
        ("Start Middle©End", "Start\xa0Middle©End"),
        # Malformed entity (no terminating ';')
        ("&amp", "&amp"),
        # Entity with extra ampersand inside (should remain unchanged)
        ("&a&b;", "&a&b;"),
        # Ampersand not part of entity
        ("Fish & Chips", "Fish & Chips"),
        # Consecutive ampersands
        ("&&;", "&&&;"),
    ],
)
def test_unescapeHTML_behaviour(inp, expected):
    assert unescapeHTML(inp) == expected


def test_unescapeHTML_type_assertion():
    # Should raise AssertionError for non‑string types (excluding None)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        unescapeHTML(123)  # int is not compat_str
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        unescapeHTML(b"bytes")  # bytes is not compat_str


def test_unescapeHTML_large_input():
    # Build a large string with many entities to ensure performance and correctness
    repeated = ("&" * 1000) + ("&unknown;" * 1000) + ("text" * 1000)
    expected = ("&" * 1000) + ("&unknown;" * 1000) + ("text" * 1000)
    assert unescapeHTML(repeated) == expected


def test_unescapeHTML_edge_cases():
    # Entity at the very start
    assert unescapeHTML("<start") == "<start"
    # Entity at the very end
    assert unescapeHTML("end>") == "end>"
    # Entity surrounded by spaces
    assert unescapeHTML("  &  ") == "  &  "
    # Multiple semicolons in a row (should treat each separately)
    assert unescapeHTML("&;;<;") == "&;;<;;"
